objective: Classify the only observed nontrivial SAT2 Q-V merge on 5x3-k3 and determine whether it is purely evaluator-side action multiplicity/dominance redundancy.
anti_circularity: values used only to explain an already observed Q-V collision
falsifiers: different action-value sets with same scalar extremum => dominance, not pure duplicate multiplicity
different extrema => SAT2 Q-V would be false
same unique transported role=>value set with different multiplicities => pure action multiplicity erasure
implication: Do not promote SAT2 as a component algebra if the only nontrivial merge is explained by Bellman idempotence over duplicate actions.
